items.text: Archie is on screen.
James is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie, James.
Exactly two men are in the room: Archie and James, and no third figure (including the player) is visible.
Archie and James are visually distinct and match their sprite masters (clothing, hair, build).
Archie and James stand in the same positions in the room as in james_meeting_5.png.
Archie stands upright, not leaning or slouching.
Both of Archie's hands are in his pockets.
Archie's mouth and posture read as talking, with his head turned toward James.
James is leaning against the workbench, with his weight on it or his hip or hands resting on it.
James faces Archie and looks at him, as if listening.
James's expression is neutral to faintly dry (a slight smirk or flat look), not smiling broadly, angry or surprised.
Nothing is in either man's hands, such as a phone, a pearl or calc, apart from Archie's hands being in his pockets.
The workshop room matches james_workshop_blank_plate.png, with the same furniture, layout and background, and no added or removed objects.
Both men are fully in frame, not cropped or hidden behind the bench, at the same scale as the room.
The image keeps the exact size and aspect ratio of the blank plate.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
